docket_entries.description: THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE BASED ON PROGRESS REPORT OF 2/20/15. PLAINTIFF WAS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFFS EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. DEFENDANTS EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. PRO TEM JUDGE: JEAN MILEFF. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (D-506)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,312.00 FILED BY RECOVEREX CORPORATION AS TO DEFENDANT LAM, BRENDA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-19-2014 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE $65.00) SERVED JAN-03-2014, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT LAM, BRENDA
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY PLAINTIFF RECOVEREX CORPORATION

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-19-2014 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO AUG-19-2014 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. "IF NO APPEARANCES, CASE CONTINUED FOR SIX MONTHS. DEFENDANT HAS AGREED TO MAKE INSTALLMENT PAYMENTS W/OUT A JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF WILL DISMISS OR FILE A SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT AFTER FULL AMOUNT IS PAID", PER JUDGE MITCHELL. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF, ONLY. PLAINTIFF WAS REPRESENTED BY JEAN--YVES LENDORMY---PRESIDENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-20-2015 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO APR-21-2015 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. IF NO APPEARANCES, CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF WAS NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF MUST APPEAR TO NOTIFY COURT REGARDING STATUS OF THIS CASE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (D-506)
